title: Task brief format
description: Define a clear assignment before the AI starts. Fill in the brackets.
body:
# Task brief

## Goal
[What should the final output achieve?]

## Audience
[Who will read or use this?]

## Tone
[e.g. professional, direct, friendly]

## Language
[e.g. English, Dutch]

## Length
[e.g. max 500 words, one page]

## Must include
- [Required point 1]
- [Required point 2]

## Must avoid
- [e.g. jargon, filler, unsupported claims]

## Deliverable
[Describe the exact output format: email, report, list, etc.]

title: Output refinement format
description: Paste AI output and specify what to improve in the next version.
body:
# Output refinement

Review the text below and produce an improved version.

## What works
- [Keep this aspect]

## What to change
- [Specific issue 1]
- [Specific issue 2]

## Rules for the revision
- Keep the core message and facts.
- Do not add new information unless I ask for it.
- Apply the same language as the original.

## Text to revise
[PASTE THE AI OUTPUT HERE]

title: Expert role format
description: Set a clear role, task, and boundaries before the AI responds.
body:
# Role and task

## Role
You are [ROLE: e.g. an experienced copywriter, a patient teacher, a critical editor].

## Task
[Describe exactly what you want done.]

## Context
[Relevant background the AI needs to know.]

## Output format
[How the answer should be structured: bullets, paragraphs, steps, etc.]

## Boundaries
- Do not [constraint 1].
- Always [requirement 1].
- If information is missing, ask before assuming.
